query: I spent the whole morning trying out the new coffee shop around the corner, their honey latte is so smooth I ended up buying a whole bag of their house blend beans to brew at home. On my way back I also stopped by the pet store, the rescue kittens they have up for adoption are so fluffy I almost brought one home with me. I was going to text my friend a photo of the kittens too, but I noticed my mobile data isn’t working at all right now. I checked my settings and airplane mode is turned on, and data mode is off, can you help me figure out how to fix this so I can use my data again?
